REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

    "the dependencies listed in the script's header."
)
FLOORS = ("'>=3.11'", "'>=3.12'", "'>=3.13'")


def read_frontmatter(skill_md: Path) -> dict:
    text = skill_md.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    m = re.match(r"^---\n(.*?)\n---\n", text, re.S)
    assert m, f"no frontmatter in {skill_md}"
    return yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) or {}


def make_tmp_skill(tmp_path: Path, name: str, fm: dict, body: str = "Body.\n") -> Path:
    d = tmp_path / "skills" / name
    d.mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / "SKILL.md").write_text(
        "---\n" + yaml.safe_dump(fm, sort_keys=False) + "---\n" + body,
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return d


def base_fm(name: str = "demo", **extra) -> dict:
    fm = {"name": name, "description": "Use when testing.", "license": "MIT"}
    fm.update(extra)
    return fm


def header(deps: str = "", floor: str = "'>=3.11'") -> str:
    return (
        "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n"
        "# /// script\n"
        f"# requires-python = {floor}\n"
        f"# dependencies = [{deps}]\n"
        "# ///\n"
    )


MAIN_GUARD = "\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n"


def write_script(skill_dir: Path, name: str, text: str) -> Path:
    s = skill_dir / "scripts"
    s.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    p = s / name
    p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return p


def floor_minor(spec: str) -> int:
    m = re.fullmatch(r">=3\.(\d+)", spec.strip())
    assert m, spec
    return int(m.group(1))

def test_compatibility_value_per_skill():
    users = set()
    for s in SKILLS:
        invs = [i for i in cf.bundled_invocations(s) if i[1] == "uv run"]
        if not invs:
            continue
        users.add(s.name)
        floors = []
        for _md, _runner, path in invs:
            target = cf.resolve_bundled_script(path, s)
            assert target is not None, (s.name, path)
            meta = cf.script_metadata(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            floors.append(floor_minor(meta["requires-python"]))
        expected = (
            "Requires uv to run bundled scripts (dependencies are declared inline); "
            f"Python 3.{max(floors)}+."
        )
        assert read_frontmatter(s / "SKILL.md").get("compatibility") == expected, s.name
    assert "finishing-a-development-branch" in users

def _prov_repo(tmp_path: Path):
    (tmp_path / "LICENSE").write_text("plain\n")
    (tmp_path / "LICENSE-x").write_text("x\n")
    for name in ("a", "b"):
        d = tmp_path / "skills" / name
        d.mkdir(parents=True)
        (d / "LICENSE").write_text("plain\n")
    (tmp_path / "skills/a/LICENSE-x").write_text("x\n")
    return tmp_path, ["a", "b"], {"LICENSE-x": ("a",)}

def test_provenance_stdlib_only():
    tree = ast.parse((REPO / "build/check_provenance.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            mods = [a.name.split(".")[0] for a in node.names]
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0 and node.module:
            mods = [node.module.split(".")[0]]
        else:
            continue
        for m in mods:
            assert m in sys.stdlib_module_names or m in local or m == "__future__", m
    claude = (REPO / "CLAUDE.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    lines = [ln for ln in claude.splitlines() if "check_provenance.py" in ln]
    assert lines and all("--with" not in ln for ln in lines)
